instruction: Extract the project context, objective, actors, scope, constraints, assumptions, and missing information from the stakeholder input.
input: Project brief for AisleMorrow Refill Signal: The objective is to coordinate replenishment of warehouse pick locations from reserve stock and close requests after destination confirmation. Order Pickers report replenishment needs and identify affected items and pick locations. Replenishment Coordinators check reserve availability and assign priorities. Reserve Stock Clerks record source locations and quantities to move. Lift Operators record moved quantities and confirm destination pick locations. Inventory Controllers close requests after destination confirmation. Purchasing warehouse stock and forecasting demand are outside the project. The priority rule and the source-location selection rule are not yet defined.

output.business_objective: Coordinate replenishment of warehouse pick locations from reserve stock and close requests after destination confirmation.
